attempts.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: L23 hotel_pool/key.png, an architectural location establishing reference for a luxury beachfront hotel rooftop. Make one uninterrupted full-detail landscape illustration at exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels, drawn edge-to-edge without borders or inset views. The Grand Harbour in a modern Korean port city: a rooftop infinity swimming pool in bright 11:00 AM late-morning autumn sunshine. Camera at 2.8 m above the rooftop deck, looking gently downward from its landward corner, about 30 m above the beach; a physically coherent wide architectural perspective. Pool 20 m long and 7 m wide, cool clear blue water with simple graphic ripple highlights, pale stone coping and a thin far overflow lip that merges optically into the distant open sea and sky. Foreground pool edge enters the lower right. To the left is a wide pale-stone deck, four white cushioned loungers with practical dark slim frames, spaced apart along the pool, and one small round low side table. Further left a single white cabana, four sturdy upright posts firmly attached to the deck, a flat white canopy and drawn-back white curtains, seating within. The infinity edge is unobstructed; a 1.1 m glass safety railing protects the dry deck side. The sweeping pale-sand beach is visibly DIRECTLY BELOW the hotel, seen beyond the deck's side railing and around the near coastline, not a faraway detached island. Along the same curving coast beyond the beach are glass city towers; working harbour piers and small gantry-crane silhouettes further along the coast, fading into restrained drawn atmospheric values. Open calm autumn sea stretches to the right and a straight level horizon in the upper third. Dominant white, cool slate blue, soft blue-grey shadows. Named key light: late-morning SUN from upper left, casting clean broad hard-edged cool-blue cel shadows from loungers and cabana posts onto the deck; small bright highlights only on water, glass and metal. Clear sky, a few hand-drawn cloud shapes, no fog, no lens flare. Drawn black architectural contours and broad flat opaque colours, not architectural CGI or photorealism. The luxurious setting must feel like a hand-inked webtoon background. Keep materials simple and matte except pool water and glass. One tiny generic adult hotel guest at the far end of the deck near the cabana, no more than 100–140 pixels tall: 1.75 m, 7.5-head adult proportions, long legs, plain pale shirt and navy trousers, one hand carrying a folded white towel, weight on one leg, feet grounded in deck perspective, seen side-back, face too small to define. This is a place key, no named story characters. Calm open sky across the top. Reference Image 1 is ONLY a house-style anchor for ink and cel shadows: do not copy its people, costumes, props, dungeon, red light, pose or composition. Make all signs, products and furnishings completely unlettered.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
problems: Pool water, caustics and deck finish look too photographic for V2 cel colouring.
